## Acceptance criteria
A1 (I1, I5): A toggle in the header switches between light and dark.
A2 (I2): Switching never alters the stored light theme.
A3: The built page is under 150 kb gzipped.
A4 (I4): User-facing text says workspace and never sandbox.
A5 (derived: tests are always needed): A test covers the toggle.
## Out of scope
- Per-page themes (stretches I1).
